# Repository Initialization

Registers a repository within the knowledge base, runs migrations, inserts an initial repo row, and writes a kc.toml configuration file. This command enables tracking and management of repositories in the knowledge compiler system.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/cli.py` — `knowledge_compiler.cli.init_cmd`
